context.handoff.title: Hand off the work
context.handoff.summary: Write down where the work stands so another session can resume it.
context.handoff.description: Records the commit the work stands on, the identity of uncommitted work (a digest of the working-tree diff and the commit it was taken against), review threads still open, evidence, and the next step. The state is yours to gather: Forge does not read git or the pull request for you. The newest 16 records are kept.

context.show.title: Show where work stands
context.show.summary: Read the latest handoff, and say whether this session still matches it.
context.show.description: Returns the latest handoff and a short summary of earlier ones. Give current (head and, if there is unfinished work, its digest) to learn whether the commit moved and whether the unfinished work is the same. Text written by earlier sessions and by reviewers comes back as untrusted content.
